newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $291 million August trade deficit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $291 million August trade deficit.

text.p: Brazil posted a $291 million trade deficit in August, with exports totalling $4.381 billion and imports at $4.672 billion, Ministry of Industry and Commerce said in a statement.
The ministry said August results brought the year-to-date trade deficit to $937 million, versus a deficit of $3.893 billion in the January-August period of 1995.
It said that August exports were 3.88 percent lower than in August a year ago.
The ministry said that exports of primary commodities in August totalled $1.211 billion, 27.64 percent of the total, compared with $1.084 billion, or 23.78 percent, in August 1995.
Semi-manufactured exports in August were $784 million, 17.9 percent of total exports, compared with $1.005 billion, or 22.05 percent, in August 1995.
Exports of manufactured goods totalled $2.34 billion, or 53.44 percent, in August, compared with $2.41 billion, or 52.87 percent, in the same month a year ago.
